narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar:
narrations.matn: “The Prophet ﷺ used to combine sunset and night prayers at Muzdalifa, as did Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq, ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb, and ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَدِّمُ الْعِيَالَ وَالضَّعَفَةَ إِلَى مِنَى مِنْ مُزْدَلِفَةٍ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith informed me that Abū al-Zubayr al-Makkī informed him, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās, who said:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ used to send family members and the weak ahead from Muzdalifa to Minā.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ يُقَدِّمُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى مِنَى مِنَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ مِنَ الْعِيَالِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith informed me, from ʿAmr b. Dīnār, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
narrations.matn: “I was among the family members whom the Messenger of God ﷺ sent ahead from Muzdalifa to Minā.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «بُعِثَ بِهِ مَعَ أَهْلِهِ إِلَى مِنَى يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، فَرَمَوُا الْجَمْرَةَ مَعَ الْفَجْرِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed me, from Shuʿba, the freedman of ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās, from Ibn ʿAbbās:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ sent him with his family to Minā on the day of sacrifice, and they stoned the pillar at dawn.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يُقَدِّمُ ضَعَفَةَ أَهْلِهِ، فَيَقِفُونَ عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ بِلَيْلٍ، فَيَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهِ مَا بَدَا لَهُمْ، ثُمَّ يُدْفَعُونَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقِفَ الْإِمَامُ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْفَعَ، فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقْدِمُ مِنًى لِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقْدِمُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَإِذَا قَدِمُوا رَمَوُا الْجَمْرَةَ، وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ: «أَرْخَصَ فِي أُولَئِكَ رَسُول اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yūnus b. Yazīd informed me, from Ibn Shihāb, that Sālim b. ʿAbd Allāh informed him:
narrations.matn: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar used to send the weak among his family ahead. They would stand at al-Mashʿar al-Ḥarām at Muzdalifa by night, remembering God as long as they wished, then depart before the imam stood and before he departed. Some would arrive at Minā for dawn prayer, others afterward. When they arrived, they would stone the pillar. Ibn ʿUmar used to say: “The Messenger of God ﷺ granted these people a concession.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَمَالِكٌ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَهُمْ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ بْن عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَفَ بِالنَّاسِ عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ يَسْأَلُونَهُ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ، يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَمْ أَشْعُرْ فَنَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ؟ فَقَالَ: «ارْمِ وَلَا
 [p. 52] حَرَجَ» ، قَالَ آخِرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي لَمْ أَشْعُرْ فَحَلَقْتُ رَأْسِي قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَ؟ فَقَالَ: «اذْبَحْ وَلَا حَرَجَ» ، قَالَ: فَمَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنْ شَيْءٍ قُدِّمَ أَوْ أُخِّرَ إِلَّا قَالَ: «افْعَلْ وَلَا حَرَجَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yūnus b. Yazīd, Mālik, and others informed me that Ibn Shihāb informed them that ʿĪsā b. Ṭalḥa b. ʿUbayd Allāh told him, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr b. al-ʿĀṣ:
narrations.matn: During the Farewell Pilgrimage the Messenger of God ﷺ stood among the people as they questioned him. A man came and said: “Messenger of God, I did not realize what I was doing, and I sacrificed before stoning.” He replied: “Stone, and there is no [p. 52] harm.” Another said: “Messenger of God, I did not realize, and I shaved my head before sacrificing.” He said: “Sacrifice, and there is no harm.” That day, whenever the Messenger of God ﷺ was asked about a rite performed earlier or later than usual, he said: “Do it, and there is no harm.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِر بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «عَرَفَةُ مَوْقِفٌ، وَكُلُّ مُزُدَلِفَةٍ مَوْقِفٍ، وَكُلُّ مِنَى مَنْحَرٍ، وَكُلُّ فِجَاجِ مَكَّةَ طَرِيقٌ ومَنْحَرٌ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Usāma b. Zayd al-Laythī informed me that ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ narrated to him that he heard Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh narrate from the Messenger of God ﷺ:
narrations.matn: A similar report to the preceding one (no. 97). He said that the Messenger of God ﷺ also said: “All of ʿArafāt is a standing-place, all of Muzdalifa is a standing-place, all of Minā is a place of sacrifice, and every path of Mecca is a thoroughfare and a place of sacrifice.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «لَمْ يَرْمُلْ فِي السَّبْعِ الَّتِي أَفَاضَ فِيهَا» ، قَالَ: قَالَ عَطَاءُ: لَا رَمْلٌ فِيهِ
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Jurayj informed me, from ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, from Ibn ʿAbbās:
narrations.matn: “The Prophet ﷺ did not walk briskly (ramal) in the seven circuits of ṭawāf al-ifāḍa.” ʿAṭāʾ said: “There is no ramal in it.”

narrations.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنَّ نَافِعًا أَخْبَرَهُمْ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» ، قَالُوا: وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» . قَالُوا: وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» ، قَالُوا: وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ»
narrations.isnad: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, Mālik b. Anas, and others narrated to me that Nāfiʿ informed them, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
narrations.matn: “O God, have mercy on those who shave their heads.” They said: “And those who trim their hair, Messenger of God?” He said: “O God, have mercy on those who shave their heads.” They said: “And those who trim their hair, Messenger of God?” He said: “O God, have mercy on those who shave their heads.” They said: “And those who trim their hair, Messenger of God?” He said: “And those who trim their hair.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْن عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلَقَ رَأْسَهُ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ shaved his head during the Farewell Pilgrimage.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ،
 [p. 53] وَغَيْرُهُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «حَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَقصَّرَ بَعْضَهُمْ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: al-Layth b. Saʿd [p. 53] and others informed me, from Nāfiʿ, who said:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ and some of his Companions shaved their heads, while others trimmed their hair.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، وابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةَ أَوَّلَ يَوْمِ ضُحَى، وَهِيَ وَاحِدَةٌ، وَأَمَّا بَعْدُ ذَلِكَ، فَبَعْدَ زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahīʿa and Ibn Jurayj informed me, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, who said:
narrations.matn: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ stone the ʿAqaba pillar on the first day in the forenoon, but on the subsequent days he stoned after the sun had passed its zenith.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عِمْرَانَ، يُحَدِّثَ أَنَّ قُدَامَةَ بْنَ عَمَّارٍ الْكِلَابِيَّ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْمِي الْجَمْرَةَ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ صَهْبَاءَ، لَا ضَرْبَ وَلَا طَرْدَ وَلَا إِلَيْكَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Sufyān al-Thawrī informed me that he heard Abū ʿImrān narrate that Qudāma b. ʿAmmār al-Kilābī said:
narrations.matn: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ stoning the pillar from a reddish she-camel; there was no striking, no driving people away, and no shouting ‘Make way!’”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يقوم بَيْنَ الْجَمْرَتَيْنِ، فَيُطِيلُ الْقِيَامَ، وَيَقُومُ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةَ الْأُخْرَى أَقَلُّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَلَا يَقُومُ عِنْدَ جَمْرَةِ الْعَقَبَةِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: al-Ḥārith b. Nabhān informed me, from Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd Allāh, from ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ used to stand between the two pillars, remaining standing for a long time. He stood for a shorter time at the other pillar, and did not stand at the ʿAqaba pillar.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْن لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْخُذُ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ، وَيَرْمِي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، ويَقُولُ: «خُذُوا مِنَّا مَنَاسِكَكُمْ، فَإِنِّي لَا أَدْرِي لَعَلِّي غَيْرَ حَاجٍّ بَعْدَ حَجَّتِي هَذِهِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahīʿa informed me, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, who said:
narrations.matn: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ pick up pebbles the size used for throwing with the fingertips and stone while riding his mount. He said: ‘Learn your pilgrimage rites from us, for I do not know whether I shall perform the pilgrimage again after this one.’”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ هُنَيْدَةَ، أَنَّ حَرْمَلَةَ ابْنَ عَمْرٍو الأَسْلَمِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ، قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَةَ،
 [p. 54] وَعَمِّي مُرْدِفِي، وَهُوَ وَاضِعٌ أُصْبُعَيْهِ أَحَدَهُمَا عَلَى الأُخْرَى، فَقُلْتُ لِعَمِّي: مَاذَا يَقُولُ: قَالَ يَقُولُ: «ارْمُوا الْجَمْرَةَ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الَخَذَفِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yaḥyā b. Ayyūb informed me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Ḥarmala al-Aslamī, from Yaḥyā b. Hunayda, that Ḥarmala b. ʿAmr al-Aslamī narrated to him:
narrations.matn: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ at ʿArafāt, [p. 54] with my uncle riding behind me. The Prophet had placed one finger upon another. I asked my uncle: ‘What is he saying?’ He replied: ‘He says: “Stone the pillar with pebbles the size of those used for fingertip throwing.”’”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْن حَزْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ أَبَا الْبَدَّاحِ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَاصِمٍ بنْ عَدِي، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «أَنَّهُ رَخَّصَ لِرِعَاءِ الإِبِلِ فِي الْبَيْتُوتَةِ يَرْمُونَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، ثُمَّ يَرْمُونَ الْغَدَ وَبَعْدَ الْغَدَ لِيَوْمَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَرْمُونَ يَوْمُ النَّفْرِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm, from his father, that Abū al-Baddāḥ informed him, from his father ʿĀṣim b. ʿAdī, from the Messenger of God ﷺ:
narrators: ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Bakr b. Muḥammad b. Ḥazm
Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. Ḥazm
narrations.matn: He granted camel herders permission regarding overnight stays: they could stone on the day of sacrifice, then stone on the next day and the following day for two days, and stone again on the day of departure.

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «رَخَّصَ لِرِعَاءِ الإِبِلِ أَنْ يَرْمُونَ الْجِمَارِ بِاللَّيْلِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Jurayj informed me, from ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ allowed camel herders to stone the pillars at night.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الرَّاعِي يَرْمِي بِاللَّيْلِ، وَيَرْعَى بِالنَّهَارِ» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿUmar b. Qays informed me, from ʿAṭāʾ, who said: I heard Ibn ʿAbbās say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
narrations.matn: “The shepherd stones at night and tends the flock by day.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْن غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yaḥyā b. Ayyūb informed me, from ʿUmāra b. Ghaziyya, from Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm, from Abū Salama b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from the Prophet ﷺ:
narrations.matn: The same as in the preceding report (no. 110).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنَّ أَيُّوبَ بْنَ أَبِِي تَمِيمَةَ أَخْبَرَهُمْ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْن عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ نَسِيَ مِنْ نُسُكِهِ شَيْئًا أَوْ تَرَكَهُ، فَلْيَهْرِيقَ دَمًا»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, Mālik b. Anas, and others informed me that Ayyūb b. Abī Tamīma informed them, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās, who said:
narrations.matn: “Whoever forgets or leaves out any part of his pilgrimage rites should offer a blood sacrifice.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، يَذْكُرُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَتْ: «طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ بَعْدَ رَمْيِ الْجَمْرَةِ الْعَقَبَةِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ṭalḥa b. ʿAmr informed me that he heard ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ report from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “I applied perfume to the Messenger of God ﷺ on the day of sacrifice, after he had stoned the ʿAqaba pillar and before he circumambulated the House.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْعُرَنِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا رَمَيْتَ الْجَمْرَةَ فَقَدْ حَلَلْتُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامًا، إِلَّا النِّسَاءُ حَتَّى تَطُوفُوا بِالْبَيْتِ» ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: وَالطِّيبُ يَا أَبَا الْعَبَّاسِ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُضَمِّخُ رَأْسَهُ بِالْمِسْكِ، أَفَطِيبٌ هُوَ أَمْ لَا؟»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Sufyān al-Thawrī informed me, from Salama b. Kuhayl, from al-Ḥasan al-ʿUranī, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
narrations.matn: “When you have stoned the pillar, everything previously forbidden to you becomes lawful except women, until you circumambulate the House.” A man asked: “And perfume, Abū al-ʿAbbās?” He replied: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ cover his head with musk. Is that perfume or not?”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُم، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أن عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، خَطَبَ النَّاسِ بِعَرَفَةَ يُعَلِّمُهُمْ أَمْرُ الْحَجِّ، وكَانَ فِيمَا قَالَ: «إِذَا جِئْتُمْ مِنَى، فَمَنْ رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ فَقَدْ حَلَّ لَهُ مَا حُرِّمَ عَلَيْهِ
 [p. 56] إِلَّا النِّسَاءُ وَالطِّيبُ، لَا يَمَسَّ أَحَدٌ نِسَاءً وَلَا طِيبًا حَتَّى يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas and more than one other person informed me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar:
narrations.matn: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb addressed the people at ʿArafāt and instructed them about the pilgrimage. Among the things he said was: “When you reach Minā, whoever stones the pillar is released from the things that were forbidden to him, [p. 56] except women and perfume. No one should touch women or perfume until he has circumambulated the House.”

narrations.arabic_text: قَالَ مَالِكٌ: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «مَنْ رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ ثُمَّ حَلَقَ أَوْ قَصَّرَ أَوْ نَحَرَ هَدْيًا إِنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ، فَقَدْ حَلَّ لَهُ مَا حُرِّمَ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا النِّسَاءُ وَالطِّيبُ، حَتَّى يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ»
narrations.isnad: Mālik said: ʿAbd Allāh b. Dīnār narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb said:
narrations.matn: “Whoever stones the pillar and then shaves or trims his hair, or sacrifices an animal if he has brought one, is released from everything previously forbidden to him, except women and perfume, until he circumambulates the House.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ: «إِذَا رَمَيْتُمُ الْجَمْرَةَ فَقَدْ حُلَّ لَكُمْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِلا النِّسَاءُ وَالطِّيبُ» ، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: «يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لِهَذَا الشَّيْخِ أَنَا طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بِيَدِي هَذَا الْيَوْمَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahīʿa informed me, from Abū al-Zubayr, that ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb said from the pulpit:
narrations.matn: “When you stone the pillar, everything becomes lawful to you except women and perfume.” ʿĀʾisha said: “May God forgive this old man! I applied perfume to the Messenger of God ﷺ with this very hand of mine on that day.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثُ، أَنَّ قَتَادَةَ بْنَ دَعَامَةَ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ وَرَقَدَ رَقْدَةً بالْمُحْصَبِ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَطَافَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith informed me that Qatāda b. Diʿāma narrated to him, from Anas b. Mālik:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ performed the noon, afternoon, sunset, and night prayers and slept for a short while at al-Muḥaṣṣab. Then he rode to the House and circumambulated it.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلِيمٍ، قَالَتْ: «اسْتَفْتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَحَاضَتْ أَوْ وَلَدَتْ بَعْدَمَا أَفَاضَتْ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَتْ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Bakr, from his father, from Abū Salama b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Umm Sulaym, who said:
narrators: Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. Ḥazm
narrations.matn: “I sought the Messenger of God's ﷺ ruling concerning a woman who menstruated or gave birth after completing ṭawāf al-ifāḍa on the day of sacrifice. The Messenger of God ﷺ gave her permission to leave.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَغَيْرُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَعُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَاِئشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَت: طَمِثَتْ صَفِيَّةُ
 [p. 57] بِنْتُ حُيَيٍّ زَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ بَعْدَمَا أَفَاضَتْ طَاهِرًا فَطَافَتْ بِالْبَيْتِ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: «أَحَابِسَتُنَا هِيَ» ؟ قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهَا قَدْ أَفَاضَتْ وَهِيَ طَاهِرَةٌ ثِمَّ طَمِثَتْ بَعْدَ الْإِفَاضَةِ. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: «فَلْتَنْفِرْ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yūnus b. Yazīd and other scholars informed me, from Ibn Shihāb, from Abū Salama b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān and ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “Ṣafiyya [p. 57] bt. Ḥuyayy, the Prophet's wife, began menstruating during the Farewell Pilgrimage after she had completed ṭawāf al-ifāḍa while pure. When the matter was mentioned to the Messenger of God ﷺ, he asked: ‘Will she delay our departure?’ I said: ‘Messenger of God, she completed ṭawāf al-ifāḍa while pure, and menstruated afterward.’ The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘Then let her depart.’”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا صَدَرَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوْ الْعُمْرَةِ أَنَاخَ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ الَّتِي بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَصَلَّى بِهَا» . قَالَ نَافِعٌ: فَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas and others informed me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar:
narrations.matn: “When the Messenger of God ﷺ was returning from pilgrimage or ʿumra, he would make his camel kneel at al-Baṭḥāʾ near Dhū al-Ḥulayfa and pray there.” Nāfiʿ said: Ibn ʿUmar used to do likewise.

narrations.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْن عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنْ غَزْوٍ، أَوْ حَجٍّ، أو عُمَرَةٍ، يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ ثَلاثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ، وَيَقُولُ: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ»
narrations.isnad: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, Mālik b. Anas, and others narrated to me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar:
narrators: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar
narrations.matn: “Whenever the Messenger of God ﷺ returned from a military expedition, pilgrimage, or ʿumra, he would pronounce ‘God is greatest’ three times upon each rise of ground and say: ‘There is no deity but God alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. We return repentant, worshiping, prostrating, praising our Lord. God has fulfilled His promise, given victory to His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.’”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، وَاللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُهِلِّينَ بِحَجٍّ مُفْرَدٍ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahīʿa and al-Layth b. Saʿd informed me, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, who said:
narrations.matn: “We approached with the Messenger of God ﷺ pronouncing the talbiya for pilgrimage alone.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، وَمَالِكُ ابْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ
 [p. 58] زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «أَهَلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحَجٍّ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahīʿa and Mālik b. Anas informed me, from Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha [p. 58], the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ entered the state of consecration for pilgrimage.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: «مَنْ قَرَنَ بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمَرَةِ، لَمْ يَطُفْ لَهُمَا إِلَّا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا، وَلَمْ يَحْلِلْ مِنْهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informed me, from Nāfiʿ, that Ibn ʿUmar said:
narrations.matn: “Whoever combines pilgrimage and ʿumra performs only one circumambulation for both and does not leave the consecrated state until the day of sacrifice.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي رِجَالٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مِنْهُمْ: أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «أَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَانُوا جَمَعُوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمَرَةَ، فَإِنَّمَا كَانُوا طَافُوا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Men of knowledge informed me, among them Anas b. Mālik, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrators: unnamed scholars including Anas b. Mālik
narrations.matn: “Those who combined pilgrimage with ʿumra performed only one circumambulation.”

narrations.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، «أَنَّهُ أَهَلَّ بِحَجَّةٍ، وَعُمْرَةٍ مَعًا، فَطَافَ لَهُمَا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا، وَسعَى لَهُمَا سَعْيًا وَاحِدًا»
narrations.isnad: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib:
narrations.matn: “He entered consecration for pilgrimage and ʿumra together, performed one circumambulation for both, and made one passage between Ṣafā and Marwa for both.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهَا قَالَت فِي الَّذِينَ كَانُوا أَهَلُّوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعُمَرةَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ: «أَنَّهُمْ طَافُوا بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ طَافُوا طَوَافًا آخَرَ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَرْجِعُوا مِنْ مِنَى»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, concerning those who entered consecration for ʿumra with the Prophet ﷺ during the Farewell Pilgrimage:
narrations.matn: “They circumambulated the House and went between Ṣafā and Marwa, then performed another circumambulation after they returned from Minā.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمَرَةِ، فَطُفْ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yaḥyā b. Ayyūb informed me, from Ḥumayd, from Bukayr b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Muzanī, from Sālim b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, from his father, who said:
narrations.matn: “If you perform pilgrimage and ʿumra separately, circumambulate for each one.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ،
 [p. 59] وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، خَرَجَ فِي الْفِتْنَةِ مُعْتَمِرًا، وَقَالَ: «إِنْ صَدَرْتُ عَنْ الْبَيْتِ صَنَعْنَا كَمَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَ أَهَلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ، وَسَارَ حَتَّى إِذَا ظَهَرَ ظَاهِرُ الْبَيْدَاءِ، الْتَفَتَ إِلَى أَصْحَابِهِ» ، فَقَالَ: «مَا أَمْرَهُمَا إِلَّا وَاحِدٌ، أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتَ الْحَجَّ مَعَ الْعُمْرَةِ» ، فَخَرَجَ حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَيْتَ، فَطَافَ بِهِ، وَطَافَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ سَبْعًا، لَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَيْهِ، وَرَأَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ مُجْزِيًا عَنْهُ، وَأَهْدَى
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas [p. 59] and others informed me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them:
narrations.matn: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar went out during the civil strife intending ʿumra and said: “If I am prevented from reaching the House, we shall do as the Messenger of God ﷺ did.” He set out in the consecrated state for ʿumra. When he reached the heights of al-Baydāʾ, he turned to his companions and said: “The two are really one affair. I call you to witness that I have now made the pilgrimage obligatory for myself together with the ʿumra.” He continued to the House and circumambulated it and went seven times between Ṣafā and Marwa. He did no more, considering it sufficient, and he offered a sacrificial animal.

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ سَالِمًا، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، كلّمَا أباهما ليالي نزل الحجاج بابن الزبير قبل أَنْ يُقْتَلَ، فَقَالَا: لَا يَضُرُّكَ أَلَّا تَحُجَّ الْعَامَ، فَإِنَّا نَخَافُ أَنْ يُحَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ، فقال {لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ} [الأحزاب: 21] ، قَدْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ مُعْتَمِرينَ فِي عَامِ الْحُدَيْبَيَةِ، فَحَالَ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ دُونَ الْبَيْتِ، فَنَحَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَدْيِهِ، وَحَلَقَ رَاسَهُ، وَحَلَّ مِنْ إِحْرَامِهِ، ثُمَّ رَجِعَ فَأَهَلَّ بِعُمَرَةٍ، وقَالَ: «إِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ، فَعَلْتَ كَمَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مَعَهُ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Samʿān informed me, from Nāfiʿ:
narrations.matn: Sālim and ʿAbd Allāh, the sons of Ibn ʿUmar, spoke to their father on the nights when al-Ḥajjāj was besieging Ibn al-Zubayr, before he was killed. They said: “It would not harm you to forgo pilgrimage this year, for we fear that you may be prevented from reaching the House.” He said: “‘You have in the Messenger of God an excellent example’ [Qurʾān 33:21]. We went out with the Messenger of God ﷺ for ʿumra in the year of al-Ḥudaybiya, and the unbelievers of Quraysh prevented him from reaching the House. The Messenger of God ﷺ sacrificed his offering, shaved his head, left the consecrated state, and returned.” He then entered consecration for ʿumra and said: “If I am prevented from reaching it, I shall do what the Messenger of God ﷺ did when I was with him.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرِ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارِ، أَنَّ هَبَّارَ بْنَ الْأَسْوَدِ جَاءَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، وَعُمَرُ يَنْحَرُ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَخْطَأْنَا كُنَّا نَرَى هَذَا الْيَوْمَ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ؟ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «اذْهَبْ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ سَبْعًا، وبَيْنَ الصَّفَا
 [p. 60] وَالْمَرْوَةِ، أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ، ثُمَّ انْحَرْ هَدْيًا إِنْ كَانَ مَعَكَ، ثُمَّ احْلِقُوا أَوْ قَصِّرُوا وَارْجِعُوا، فَإِذَا كَانَ حَجٌّ قَابِلٌ، فَحُجُّوا وَاهْدُوا، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ، فَصِيَامُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْحَجِّ وَسَبْعَةٍ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas, ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, and others informed me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them, from Sulaymān b. Yasār:
narrations.matn: Habbār b. al-Aswad came on the day of sacrifice while ʿUmar was offering a sacrifice and said: “Commander of the Believers, we made a mistake: we thought today was the day of ʿArafāt.” ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb said: “Go to Mecca and circumambulate the House seven times, and go between Ṣafā [p. 60] and Marwa, you and those with you. Then sacrifice an animal if you have one, shave or trim your hair, and return. When the next pilgrimage comes, perform it and offer a sacrifice. Whoever cannot find one must fast three days during the pilgrimage and seven when you return.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عِرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: " خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمِنَّا مِنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجَّةٍ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجٍّ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، قَالَتْ: فَأمَّا مَنْ أَحْرَمَ بِالْحَجِّ أَوْ جَمَعَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ، فَلَمْ يَحِلَّ، وَحَلَّ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا أَهَلُّوا بِالعُمْرَةِ "
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas and Ibn Lahīʿa informed me, from Abū al-Aswad, from ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “We set out with the Messenger of God ﷺ. Some of us entered consecration for pilgrimage, some for ʿumra and pilgrimage together, and some for ʿumra alone. Those who consecrated themselves for pilgrimage or combined pilgrimage and ʿumra did not leave the consecrated state, while those who consecrated themselves for ʿumra did.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ: «مَنِ اعْتَمَرَ فِي أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ، فُي شَوَّالٍ أَوْ ذِي الْقِعْدَةِ أَوْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ، فَقَدِ اسْتَمْتَعَ وَوَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْهَدْيُ، أَوْ الصِّيَامُ إِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ هَدْيًا» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Dīnār, who said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar say:
narrations.matn: “Whoever performs ʿumra in the pilgrimage months—Shawwāl, Dhū al-Qaʿda, or Dhū al-Ḥijja—has performed tamattuʿ and owes a sacrificial offering, or fasting if he cannot find one.”

narrations.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، مِثْلَهُ
narrations.isnad: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar and more than one other person narrated to me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar:
narrations.matn: The same as in the preceding report (no. 134).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنْ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: «مَنِ اعْتَمَرَ فِي أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ، فَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ، وَلَمْ يَصُمِ الثَّلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ قَبْلَ أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ، فَلْيَصُمْ أَيّامَ مِنَى»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿUmar b. Muḥammad, ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, and others informed me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them that ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar said:
narrations.matn: “Whoever performs ʿumra during the pilgrimage months but has no sacrificial offering, and has not fasted the three days before the days of Tashrīq, should fast during the days of Minā.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسِ،
 [p. 61] عَنَ ابْن شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «الصِّيَامُ لِمَنْ تَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ هَدْيًا مَا بَيْنَ أَنْ يُهِلَّ بِالْحَجِّ إِلَى يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَصُمْ صَامَ أَيَّامَ عَرَفَةَ» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas [p. 61] informed me, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “The fasting required of one who joins ʿumra to pilgrimage, when he cannot find an animal to sacrifice, can be done between entering consecration for pilgrimage and the day of ʿArafāt. If he has not fasted, he may fast during the days of ʿArafāt.”

narrations.arabic_text: قَالَ مَالِكٌ: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
narrations.isnad: Mālik said: Ibn Shihāb also narrated to me, from Sālim b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, from his father:
narrations.matn: The same as in the preceding report (no. 137).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ: «افْصِلُوا بَيْنَ حَجِّكُمْ وَعُمْرَتِكُمْ، فَإِنَّهُ أَتَمُّ لِحَجِّ أَحَدُكُمْ، وَأَتَمُّ لِعُمْرَتِهِ أَنْ يَعْتَمِرَ فِي غَيْرِ أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, Mālik b. Anas, and others informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, that ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb said:
narrations.matn: “Separate your pilgrimage and ʿumra, for that makes each person's pilgrimage more complete, and makes his ʿumra more complete if he performs it outside the pilgrimage months.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ وَرْدَانَ التُّجِيبِيُّ، «أَنَّهُ رَأَى عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُعْتَمِرَةَ فِي ذِي الْحِجَّةِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ḥarmala b. ʿImrān al-Tujībī informed me that ʿUbayd b. Wardān al-Tujībī narrated to him:
narrations.matn: “He saw ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, performing ʿumra in Dhū al-Ḥijja.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْن أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، قَالَتْ: «كَانَتْ عائِشَةُ تَعْتَمِرُ بِمَكَّةَ بَعْدَ الْحَجِّ» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAlqama b. Abī ʿAlqama, from his mother, who said:
narrations.matn: “ʿĀʾisha used to perform ʿumra in Mecca after the pilgrimage.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِم، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، مِثْلَهُ
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informed me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾisha:
narrations.matn: The same as in the preceding report (no. 141).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، «أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْمَرَ عَائِشَةَ مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ لَيْلَةَ الْحَصْبَةِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: al-Layth b. Saʿd informed me that Abū al-Zubayr reported to him, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ arranged for ʿĀʾisha to perform ʿumra from al-Tanʿīm on the night of al-Ḥaṣba.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ،
 [p. 62] عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَتْ: " تَمَّتْ عُمْرَةُ الدَّهْرِ كُلِّهِ إِلَّا أَرْبَعَةَ أَيَّامٍ: يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ، وَثَلاثةُ أَيَّام التَّشْرِيقِ "
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿĪsā b. Yūnus informed me [p. 62], from Saʿīd b. Abī ʿArūba, from Qatāda, from Muʿādha al-ʿAdawiyya, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “ʿUmra may be performed throughout the entire year except for four days: the day of sacrifice and the three days of Tashrīq.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ: «أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَعْتَمِرُ فِي رَجَبٍ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informed me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾisha:
narrations.matn: “She used to perform ʿumra during Rajab.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ: «كَانَتْ تَعْتَمِرُ فِي آخِرِ ذِي الْحَجَّةِ مِنَ الْجُحْفَةِ، وَتَعْتَمِرُ فِي رَجَبٍ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَتُهِلُّ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yaḥyā b. Ayyūb and Ibn Samʿān informed me, from Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd, from Saʿīd b. al-Musayyab:
narrations.matn: “ʿĀʾisha used to perform ʿumra from al-Juḥfa at the end of Dhū al-Ḥijja, and ʿumra from Medina in Rajab, entering consecration at Dhū al-Ḥulayfa.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ: «أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَأْتِي الْجُحْفَةَ قَبْلَ هِلَالِ الْمُحَرَّمِ، فتَقَيِمُ بِهَا حَتَّى تَرَى الْهِلَالَ، فَإِذَا رَأَتِ الْهِلَالَ أَهَلَّتْ بِعُمْرَةٍ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAlqama, from his mother, from ʿĀʾisha:
narrations.matn: “She would go to al-Juḥfa before the new moon of Muḥarram and stay there until she saw the crescent. When she saw it, she would enter consecration for ʿumra.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَعْتَمِرُ فِي رَجَبٍ وَيَهْدِي» ، قَالَ نَافِعٌ: «وَلَيْسَ الْهَدْيُ بِوَاجِبٍ، إِنَّمَا كَانَ مِنْهُ تَطَوُّعًا»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar and Usāma b. Zayd informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar:
narrations.matn: “He used to perform ʿumra in Rajab and bring a sacrificial offering.” Nāfiʿ said: “The offering was not obligatory; he gave it voluntarily.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرُ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، قَالَ: كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يُنْكِرُ الِاشْتِرَاطَ فِي الْحَجِّ، وَيَقُولُ: «أَلَيْسَ حَسْبُكُمْ سنة
 [p. 63] رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنْ حُصِرَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَنِ الْحَجِّ، طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ حَلَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى يَحُجَّ عَامًا قَابِلًا، وَيَهْدِي أَوْ يَصُومُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ» . قَالَ يُونُسُ: قَالَ رَبِيعَةُ: «لَا نَعْلَمُ شَرْطٍ يَجُوزُ فِي إِحْرَامٍ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar and Usāma b. Zayd informed me, from Ibn Shihāb, from Sālim:
narrations.matn: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar disapproved of attaching conditions to the pilgrimage and said: “Is the example [p. 63] of the Messenger of God ﷺ not sufficient for you? If one of you is prevented from completing the pilgrimage, he should circumambulate the House and go between Ṣafā and Marwa, then be released from all restrictions until he performs pilgrimage the following year. He must offer a sacrifice or fast if he cannot find one.” Yūnus said: Rabīʿa said: “We know of no condition that is valid in the state of consecration.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثُ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَتْ: قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، وَلَمْ أَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَلَا بَيْتِ الصَّفَا واَلْمَرْوَةِ، فَشَكَوْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: «افْعَلِي مَا يَفْعَلُ الْحَاجُّ غَيْرَ أَنْ لَا تَطُوفِي بِالْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَطْهُرِي»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith and Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “I arrived in Mecca while menstruating and had not circumambulated the House or gone between Ṣafā and Marwa. I complained to the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: ‘Do everything the pilgrim does, except that you must not circumambulate the House until you become pure.’”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ، فَقَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، فَلَمْ أَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَلَا بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَشَكَوْتُ ذَلِك إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: «أَهِلِّي بِالْحَجِّ وَدَعِي الْعُمْرَةَ» ، فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا الْحَجَّ أَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ إِلَى التَّنْعِيمِ، فَاعْتَمَرَتْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَذِهِ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِكِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha, who said:
narrations.matn: “We set out with the Messenger of God ﷺ, and I entered consecration for ʿumra. I reached Mecca while menstruating, so I did not circumambulate the House or go between Ṣafā and Marwa. I complained to the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: ‘Enter consecration for pilgrimage and leave the ʿumra.’ When we finished the pilgrimage, he sent me with ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Bakr to al-Tanʿīm, and I performed ʿumra. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘This takes the place of your ʿumra.’”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرَ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ أَقْبَلَتْ مُهلَّةً بِعُمَرَةٍ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَتْ بِسَرَفَ عَرَكَتْ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَهَا تَبْكِي، فَقَالَ: «مَا يُبْكِيكِ؟» قَالَتْ: حِضْتُ، وَلَمْ أَحْلِلْ
 [p. 64] وَلَمْ أَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَالنَّاسُ يَذْهَبُونَ إِلَى الْحَجِّ الْآنَ، قَالَ: «فِإِنَّ هَذَا أَمْرٌ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ، فَاغْتَسِلِي ثُمَّ أَهِلِّي بِالْحَجِّ» . فَفَعَلْتُ وَوَقَفْتُ الْمَوَاقِفَ حَتَّى إِذَا طَهُرْتُ طُفْتُ بِالْكَعْبَةِ وَبِالْصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «قَدْ حَلَلْتِ مِنْ حَجِّكِ وَعُمْرَتِكِ جمَيِعًا» ، فقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَجِدُ فِي نَفْسِي أَنِّي لَمْ أَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ حَتَّى حَجَجْتُ، قَالَ: «فَاذْهَبْ بِهَا يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ، فَأَعْمِرْهَا مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ، وَذَلِكَ لَيْلَةَ الْحَصْبَةِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: al-Layth b. Saʿd informed me that Abū al-Zubayr told him, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh:
narrations.matn: ʿĀʾisha set out in consecration for ʿumra, but when she reached Sarif she began menstruating. The Prophet ﷺ entered and found her weeping. He asked: “What makes you weep?” She said: “I have menstruated and have not left consecration [p. 64] or circumambulated the House, while the people are now going to perform the pilgrimage.” He said: “This is something God has ordained for the daughters of Adam. Bathe, then enter consecration for pilgrimage.” She did so, stood at the pilgrimage stations, and after becoming pure circumambulated the Kaʿba and went between Ṣafā and Marwa. He then told her: “You have completed both your pilgrimage and your ʿumra.” She said: “Messenger of God, I still feel troubled that I did not circumambulate the House before performing the pilgrimage.” He said: “ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, take her and arrange an ʿumra for her from al-Tanʿīm.” This was on the night of al-Ḥaṣba.

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ عُمَيْسٍ، وَلَدَتْ مُحَمَّدَ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ بِالْبَيْدَاءِ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: «مُرْهَا فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ، ثُمَّ تُهِلَّ» . إِلَّا أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ.
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar and Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. al-Qāsim, from his father:
narrations.matn: Asmāʾ bt. ʿUmays gave birth to Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr al-Ṣiddīq at al-Baydāʾ. Abū Bakr mentioned this to the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: “Tell her to bathe and enter consecration.” Ibn ʿUmar's version, however, says: “At Dhū al-Ḥulayfa.”

narrations.arabic_text: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ.
narrations.isnad: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar said: Nāfiʿ also narrated to me:
narrations.matn: The same as in the preceding report (no. 153).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَاللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَهُمْ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، مِثْلَهُ عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yūnus b. Yazīd, ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith, and al-Layth b. Saʿd informed me that Ibn Shihāb told them, from Saʿīd b. al-Musayyab:
narrations.matn: The same account as in no. 153, attributed to the Prophet ﷺ.

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «لَا يَحِلُّ لِامْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ
 [p. 65] وَلَيْلَةٍ إِلَّا مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from Saʿīd b. Abī Saʿīd al-Maqburī, from Abū Hurayra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
narrations.matn: “It is not lawful for a woman who believes in God and His Messenger to travel the distance of a day [p. 65] and a night unless accompanied by one of her unmarriageable male relatives (maḥram).”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَاللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَهُمَا، أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارِ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، قَالَ: كَانَ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَدِيفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: فَأَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم امْرَأَةً مِنْ خَثْعَمٍ تَسْتَفْتِيهِ، فَجَعَلَ الْفَضْلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا وَتَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ، فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَ الْفَضلِ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الشِّقِّ الْآخِرِ، قَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ فِي الْحَجِّ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ أَدْرَكْتَ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَثْبُتَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ، " أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ ". وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas and al-Layth b. Saʿd informed me that Ibn Shihāb told them that Sulaymān b. Yasār told him that ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās said:
narrations.matn: al-Faḍl b. ʿAbbās was riding behind the Messenger of God ﷺ when a woman from Khathʿam came to ask a legal question. Al-Faḍl began looking at her and she at him, and the Messenger of God ﷺ turned al-Faḍl's face to the other side with his hand. She said: “Messenger of God, God's obligation of pilgrimage has reached my father when he is an elderly man who cannot remain steady on his riding animal. May I perform pilgrimage on his behalf?” He said: “Yes.” This was during the Farewell Pilgrimage.

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أيَّوبَ بْنِ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: إِنِّي أُمِّي امْرَأَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ، لَا تَسْتَطِيعَ أَنْ نُرْكِبَهَا الْبَعِيرَ، لَا تَسْتَمْسِكُ، وَإِنْ رَبَطْتُهَا خِفْتَ أَنْ تَمُوتَ، أََفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهَا؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from Ayyūb b. Abī Tamīma, from Muḥammad b. Sīrīn, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās:
narrations.matn: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “My mother is an elderly woman. We cannot get her onto a camel, for she cannot hold on, and if I tied her to it I would fear she might die. May I perform pilgrimage on her behalf?” He said: “Yes.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنِ قَتَادَةَ بْنِ دَعَامَةَ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرُ حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، مَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلٌ يُهِلُّ، يَقُولُ: لَبَّيْكَ بِحَجَّةٍ عَنْ شَبْرَمَةَ، فَقَالَ: وَمَا شَبْرَمَةُ؟ قَالَ: أَوْصَى أَنْ يَحُجَّ عَنْه، قَالَ «أَحَجَجْتَ أَنْتَ» ؟ قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «فَابْدَأْ أَنْتَ فَحُجَّ عَنْ نَفْسِكَ، ثُمَّ احْجُجْ عَنْ شَبْرَمَة»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith informed me, from Qatāda b. Diʿāma, that Saʿīd b. Jubayr narrated to him:
narrations.matn: A man passed by ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās reciting the pilgrimage talbiya: “Here I am to perform pilgrimage for Shubruma.” Ibn ʿAbbās asked: “Who is Shubruma?” He replied: “He bequeathed that pilgrimage be performed for him.” Ibn ʿAbbās asked: “Have you performed pilgrimage yourself?” He answered: “No.” He said: “First perform your own pilgrimage, then perform pilgrimage for Shubruma.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدِ بْن جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْن عُجْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْرِمًا، فَآذَاهُ الْقَمْلُ، فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَحْلِقَ رَأْسَهُ، وقَالَ: «صُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ أَطْعِمْ سِتَّةَ مَسَاكِينَ، مُدَّيْنِ مُدَّيْنِ، أَوْ انْسُكْ شَاةٍ، أَيُّ ذَلِكَ فَعَلْتَ أَجْزَأَ عَنْكَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jazarī, from Mujāhid b. Jubayr, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb b. ʿUjra:
narrations.matn: He was in consecration with the Messenger of God ﷺ when lice afflicted him. The Messenger of God ﷺ instructed him to shave his head and said: “Fast three days, or feed six poor people two mudds apiece, or sacrifice a sheep. Whichever you do will suffice.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ: «كَانَ يُقَطِّرُ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ الصَّبِرَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ḥafṣ b. Maysara informed me, from Mūsā b. ʿUqba, from Nāfiʿ:
narrations.matn: “ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar used to put drops of aloe in his eyes while in the consecrated state.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، واللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahīʿa, al-Layth b. Saʿd, and ʿAmr b. Qays informed me, from ʿAṭāʾ b. Abī Rabāḥ, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ underwent cupping while in the consecrated state.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْن عُمَرَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informed me, from Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl, from Anas b. Mālik:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ underwent cupping while in the consecrated state.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ: " أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ بِمَكَانٍ مِنْ طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ يُقَالَ لَهُ: لَحْيُ جَمَلٍ "
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas and more than one other person informed me, from Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd, from Sulaymān b. Yasār:
narrations.matn: “The Prophet ﷺ underwent cupping while in the consecrated state at a place on the Mecca road called Laḥy Jamal.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ: " أَنَّ رَبِيعَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ: «أَنَّ أَبَا هِنْدَ يَسَارَ الشَّامِيَّ هُوَ حَجَمَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَرْنٍ، وَشَفْرَةٍ مِنَ الشَّكْوَى الَّذِي كَانَ يَعْتَرِيهِ مِنَ الْأَكْلَةِ الَّتِي أَكَلَهَا
 [p. 67] بِخَيْبَرَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Samʿān informed me that Rabīʿa told him:
narrations.matn: “Abū Hind Yasār al-Shāmī was the one who performed cupping on the Messenger of God ﷺ with a horn and a blade because of a complaint resulting from the food he had eaten [p. 67] at Khaybar.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يُشْعِرُ بَدَنَهُ مِنَ الشَّقِّ الأَيْسَرِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ صِعَابًا مُقْرَّنَةٌ، فَإِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بَيْنَهَا، أَشْعَرَ مِنَ الشِّقِّ الْأَيْمَنِ، وَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَشْعِرَهَا، وَجَّهَهَا إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ، وَإِذَا أَشْعَرَهَا قَالَ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ» . وَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُشْعِرُهَا بِيَدِهِ، وَيَنْحَرُهَا بِيَدِهِ قِيَامًا
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas and ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informed me, from Nāfiʿ:
narrations.matn: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar used to mark his sacrificial camels on the left side unless they were difficult animals tied together. If he could not get between them he marked the right side. When about to mark them, he faced them toward the qibla and said: “In the name of God; God is greatest.” He marked them with his own hand and slaughtered them himself while they were standing.

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ: «كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ الْقَلائِدَ لِهَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْغَنَمُ، ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ بِهَا وَيَقْعُدُ حَلَالًا»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: al-Ḥārith b. Nabhān informed me, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾisha, who said:
narrations.matn: “I used to weave the garlands for the sheep sent as sacrificial offerings by the Messenger of God ﷺ. He would then send them off and remain at home without entering the consecrated state.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَنَا أَفْلَحُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «فَتَلْتُ قَلَائِدَ هَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي، ثُمَّ قَلَّدَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ وَأَعْرَهَا وَسَاقَهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ، وَتَخَلَّفَ عَنِ الْحَجِّ، فَمَا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ كَانَ لَهُ حَلالا»
narrations.isnad: Aflaḥ b. Ḥumayd informed me that al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad narrated to him, from ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “I wove the garlands for the Messenger of God's ﷺ sacrificial animals with my own hands. The Messenger of God ﷺ then garlanded them with his own hands, marked them, and drove them toward the House, while he himself remained behind instead of performing the pilgrimage. Nothing previously lawful became forbidden to him.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قالت: «فَتَلْتُ قَلَائِدَ هَدْيِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي، ثُمَّ قَلَّدَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِهَا مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، لَمْ يَحْرُمْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ شَيْءٌ كَانَ أَحَلَّهُ اللَّهُ لَهُ حَتَّى نَحَرَ الْهَدْيَ» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Bakr, from ʿAmra bt. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿĀʾisha, who said:
narrations.matn: “I wove the garlands for the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of God ﷺ with my own hands. He garlanded them with his own hands and then sent them with Abū Bakr. Nothing God had made lawful to him became forbidden to the Messenger of God ﷺ until the sacrificial animals were slaughtered.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي رِجَالٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، وَأَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْن الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Men of knowledge informed me, from Hishām b. ʿUrwa and Abū al-Aswad, from ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾisha, from the Messenger of God ﷺ:
narrations.matn: The same subject as in the preceding reports (nos. 167–169); no independent wording is supplied here.

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، ومُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «مَا نَعْلَمُ حَرَامًا يُحِلُّهُ إِلَّا الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith informed me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. al-Qāsim and Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad, from ʿĀʾisha, who said:
narrations.matn: “We know of nothing that releases one from the restrictions of consecration except circumambulating the House.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُهُمَا، أَنَّ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَهُمْ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائُشَةَ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْهَا، تَقُولُ: «لَا يُحْرِمُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ وَلَبَّى»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith, Mālik b. Anas, and others informed me that Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd narrated to them, from ʿAmra, from ʿĀʾisha, whom she heard say:
narrations.matn: “Only a person who has entered consecration and pronounced the talbiya is bound by its prohibitions.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: «الْهَدْيُ مَا قُلِّدَ وَأُشْعِرَ، وَوُقِفَ بِهِ بِعَرَفَةَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Mālik b. Anas, ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, and more than one other person informed me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them that ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar said:
narrations.matn: “An offering (hady) is one that has been garlanded, marked, and made to stand at ʿArafāt.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ: «فِي الْبُدْنِ الثَّنْيُ فَمَا فَوْقَهُ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, Mālik b. Anas, and more than one other person informed me that Nāfiʿ narrated to them that ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar used to say:
narrations.matn: “For a sacrificial camel, an animal of the thanī age or older is required.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: «وَكُلُّ هَدْيٍ لَمْ يُقَلَّدْ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ وَيُوقَفْ، فَهُوَ جَزُورٌ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Usāma b. Zayd al-Laythī informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
narrations.matn: “Any sacrificial animal that is not garlanded on the day of ʿArafāt and brought to stand there is merely an animal slaughtered for meat.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَسَعِيدٌ الْجُمَحِيُّ، ومالك، وغيرهم، أَنَّ هِشَامَ بْنَ عُرْوَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
 [p. 69] أَنَّ صَاحِبَ هَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلَهُ: كَيْفَ نَصْنَعُ بِمَا عَطِبَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «انْحَرْهَا، وَأَلْقِ قَلَائِدَهَا وَنِعَالَها فِي دَمِهَا، وَخَلِّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ النَّاسِ يَأْكُلُونَهَا»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh, Saʿīd al-Jumaḥī, Mālik, and others informed me that Hishām b. ʿUrwa reported, from his father [p. 69]:
narrations.matn: The man in charge of the Messenger of God's ﷺ sacrificial animals asked him: “What should we do with an offering that collapses?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Slaughter it, cast its garlands and sandals into its blood, and leave it for people to eat.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَنَّ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ، وَعَمْرَو بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «نَحَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبَيَةِ الْبَدَنَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ، وَالْبَقَرَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ»
narrations.isnad: Mālik b. Anas and ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, who said:
narrations.matn: “We slaughtered with the Messenger of God ﷺ in the year of al-Ḥudaybiya, a camel on behalf of seven people and a cow on behalf of seven.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ بَدَنَةً، فَلَمْ أَجِدْهَا؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «اذْبَحْ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْغَنَمِ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ismāʿīl b. ʿAyyāsh informed me, from ʿAṭāʾ al-Khurāsānī, from Ibn ʿAbbās:
narrations.matn: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “I vowed to offer a camel, but I could not find one.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Slaughter seven sheep.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عِرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا أُضِلَّتْ لَهَا بَدَنَتَانِ، فَأَرْسَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ بِأُخْرَيَيْنِ، فَنَحَرَتْهُمَا، ثُمَّ وَجَدَتْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ اللَّتَيْنِ ضَلَّتَا فَنَحَرَتْهُمَا "
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith informed me, from Hishām b. ʿUrwa, from his father, from ʿĀʾisha:
narrations.matn: Two of her sacrificial camels were lost, so ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Zubayr sent her two others, and she slaughtered them. Later she found the two that had been lost and slaughtered those as well.

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ عَجْلَانَ مَوْلَى الْمُشْمَعِلِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنْ رُكُوبِ الْهَدْيِ، قَالَ: إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ؟ قَالَ: «ارْكَبْهَا وَيْلَكَ»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed me, from ʿAjlān, the freedman of al-Mushamʿil, from Abū Hurayra:
narrations.matn: The Messenger of God ﷺ was asked about riding a sacrificial animal. Someone said: “But it is a sacrificial camel!” He replied: “Ride it, confound you!”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَكَ ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عِمَارَةَ بْنِ غُزَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ هَذَا كِتَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 [p. 70] صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ: «صَدَقَةُ الْغَنَمِ لَيْسَ فِيهَا صَدَقَةٌ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ أَرْبَعِينَ شَاةً، فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ أََرْبَعِينَ شَاةً، فَفِيهَا شَاةٌ، إِلَى عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةٍ، فَإِذا كَانَتْ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةٍ، فَفِيهَا شَاتَانِ إِلَى مِائَتَيْ شَاةٍ، فَإِذَا كَانَتْ مِائَتَيْ شَاةٍ وَشَاةٍ، فَفِيهَا ثَلاثُ شِيَاهٍ، إِلَّا ثَلَاثِمِائَةِ شَاةٍ، فَمَا زَادَ فَفِي كُلِّ مِائَةِ شَاةٍ، وَلَا يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ مُتْفَرِّقٍ، وَلَا يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَ مُجْتَمِعٍ خَشْيَةَ الصَّدَقَةَ، وَلَا يُخْرَجُ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ هِرْمَةٌ، وَلَا ذَاتُ عَوَارٍ، وَلَا تَيْسٌ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ الْمُصَدِّقُ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ خَلِيطَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَتَرَاجَعَانِ بِالسَّوِيَّةِ» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Lahīʿa informs you, from ʿUmāra b. Ghaziyya, who was informed by ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Bakr b. Ḥazm:
narrators: ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Bakr b. Ḥazm
narrations.matn: This is the letter of the Messenger of God ﷺ [p. 70] to ʿAmr b. Ḥazm: “Concerning alms on sheep: none is due until the flock reaches forty. At forty sheep, one sheep is due up to one hundred and twenty. At one hundred and twenty-one, two sheep are due up to two hundred. At two hundred and one, three sheep are due up to three hundred. Beyond that, one sheep is due for every hundred. Separate flocks must not be combined, nor a single flock separated, out of fear of alms assessment. No decrepit animal, defective animal, or male goat is to be taken, unless the collector wishes. Partners in a mixed flock must settle between themselves fairly.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، وعَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابني عبد الله بن عمر، عن رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوُ ذَلِكَ
narrations.isnad: Yūnus informs you, from Ibn Shihāb, from Sālim and ʿAbd Allāh, the two sons of ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, from the Messenger of God ﷺ:
narrators: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar
narrations.matn: An account similar to the preceding report (no. 181).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عُمَرِ الْمَعَافِرِيِّ، عَمَّنْ، سَمِعَ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرِ الْجُهَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ: «بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاعِيًا، فَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ بِأَكْلِ الصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَذِنَ لِي»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Lahīʿa informs you, from Yazīd b. ʿUmar al-Maʿāfirī, from someone who heard ʿUqba b. ʿĀmir al-Juhanī say:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ sent me out as a collector. I asked him for permission to eat from the alms, and he gave me permission.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْن سَالِمٍ، وَمَالِكٌ، وَسُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، وَسُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيَّ حَدَّثَهُمْ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونِ خَمْسِ أَوَاقٍ مِنَ الْوَرَقِ صَدَقةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ أَوْسُقٍ مِنَ التَّمْرِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ مِنَ الإِبِلِ صَدَقَةٌ» .
narrations.isnad: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Sālim, Mālik, Sufyān al-Thawrī, and Sufyān b. ʿUyayna inform you that ʿAmr b. Yaḥyā al-Māzinī narrated to them, from his father, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
narrators: Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Sālim
narrations.matn: “No alms are due on less than five ūqiyyas of silver, no alms on less than five wasqs of dates, and no alms on fewer than five camels.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ عِيَاضُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقُرَشِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
narrations.isnad: ʿIyāḍ b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Qurashī informs you, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, from the Messenger of God ﷺ:
narrations.matn: The same as in the preceding report (no. 184).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، وَالْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَاصِم بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، وَالْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «هَاتُوا لِي رُبْعَ الْعُشُورِ، مِنْ كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَمًا دِرْهَمٌ، وَحَالَ عَلَيْهَا الْحَوْلُ، فَفِيهَا خَمْسَةَ دَرَاهِمَ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ لَكَ عِشْرُونَ دِينَارًا، فَإِذَا كَانَتْ لَكَ، وَحَالَ عَلَيْهَا الْحَوْلُ، فَفِيهَا نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ فَمَا زَادَ، فَبِحِسَابِ ذَلِك» . قَالَ: فَلَا أَدْرِي أَعَلِيٌّ، يَقُولُ: بِحِسَابِ ذَلِكَ أَمْ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، إِلَّا أَنَّ جَرِيرًا قَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَلَيْسَ فِي مَالِ زَكَاةٍ حَتَّى يَحُولَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَوْلُ»
narrations.isnad: Jarīr b. Ḥāzim and al-Ḥārith b. Nabhān inform you, from al-Ḥasan b. ʿUmāra, from Abū Isḥāq al-Hamdānī, from ʿĀṣim b. Ḍamra and al-Ḥārith b. ʿAbd Allāh, from ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib, from the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said:
narrations.matn: “Bring me the quarter of a tenth: one dirham out of every forty dirhams. When a year has passed over [two hundred dirhams], five dirhams are due. Nothing is due from you until you own twenty dinars. When you own them and a year has passed, half a dinar is due, and what exceeds that is assessed proportionally.” The narrator said: “I do not know whether ʿAlī himself said ‘proportionally’ or attributed it to the Prophet ﷺ.” Jarīr, however, included in the prophetic report: “No zakāt is due on wealth until a year has passed over it.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدٍ، وَغَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُمْ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ فِي الْحُلِيِّ زَكَاةٌ»
narrations.isnad: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, Mālik b. Anas, Usāma b. Zayd, Yūnus b. Yazīd, and more than one other person inform you that Nāfiʿ narrated to them, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, who said:
narrations.matn: “No zakāt is due on jewelry.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَكَ مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَرَّامِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ فِي عَبْدِهِ وَلَا فِي
 [p. 72] فَرَسِهِ صَدَقَةٌ»
narrations.isnad: Mālik informs you, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Dīnār, from Sulaymān b. Yasār, from ʿArrām b. Mālik, from Abū Hurayra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
narrations.matn: “No alms are due from a Muslim on his slave or [p. 72] his horse.”

narrations.arabic_text: حَدَّثَكَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «لَا صَدَقَةَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فِي خَيْلِهِ وَلَا فِي رَقِيقِهِ»
narrations.isnad: Usāma b. Zayd al-Laythī narrated to you, from Makḥūl, from ʿIrāk b. Mālik, from Abū Hurayra, from the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said:
narrations.matn: “No alms are due from a man on his horses or his slaves.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، وَسُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ، قَالَ: «عَفَوْتُ عَنِ الْخَيْلِ وَالرَّقِيقِ» ، قَالَ: الثَّوْرِيُّ فِي الْحَدِيثِ: «فَأَدُّوا زَكَاةَ الْأَمْوَالِ»
narrations.isnad: Sufyān b. ʿUyayna and Sufyān al-Thawrī inform you, from Abū Isḥāq al-Hamdānī, from al-Ḥārith, from ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
narrations.matn: “I have exempted horses and slaves.” Al-Thawrī included in the report: “So pay the zakāt of wealth.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «فِيمَا سَقَتِ الأَنْهَارُ وَالْغَيْمُ الْعُشُورُ، وَمَا سَقَى السَّانِيَةُ نِصْفُ الْعُشُورِ»
narrations.isnad: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith informs you that Abū al-Zubayr narrated to him that he heard Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh mention that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
narrations.matn: “On crops watered by rivers and rainclouds, a tenth is due; on what is irrigated using a water-drawing device, half a tenth is due.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، وَالْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ حَرَامِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُتَيْقٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «احْتَاطُوا لِأَهْلِ الْأَمْوَالِ فِي الْوَاطِئَةِ، وَالْعَامِلَةِ، وَالنَّوَائِبِ، وَمَا وَجَبَ فِي الثَّمَرِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ»
narrations.isnad: Muslim b. Khālid and al-Qāsim b. ʿAbd Allāh inform you, from Ḥarām b. ʿUthmān, from Abū ʿAtīq, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
narrations.matn: “Be considerate of the owners of property regarding the needs of those coming and going, the workers, unexpected obligations, and the right due upon fruit.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَكَ يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرُو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ: «أَنَّ بَنِي شَبَابَةِ بَطْنُ مَنْ فَهِمَ، كَانُوا يُؤَدُّونَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ نَخْلٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهُمْ الْعُشْرِ مِنْ كُلِّ عَشَرَةَ،
 [p. 73] قُرْبُ قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ بِحِمًى لَهُمْ وَادِيَيْنِ لَهُمْ، ثُمَّ أَدُّوا إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ مَا كَانُوا يُؤَدُّونَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَمَى لَهُمْ وَادٍ بَيْنَهُمْ»
narrations.isnad: Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Sālim informs you, from ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ḥārith al-Makhzūmī, from ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather:
narrators: Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Sālim
narrations.matn: “Banū Shabāba, a branch of Fahm, used to pay the Prophet ﷺ one-tenth of the dates from palm groves belonging to them, one of every ten, [p. 73] near a village associated with two valleys in their protected grazing land. They then paid ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb what they had paid the Prophet ﷺ, and he protected a valley between them for their use.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، «أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَضَ عَلَى النَّاسِ زَكَاةِ الْفِطْرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، عَلَى كُلِّ حُرٍّ أَوْ عَبْدٍ، ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى، مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ»
narrations.isnad: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar and Mālik b. Anas inform you, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar:
narrations.matn: “The Messenger of God ﷺ prescribed the alms of breaking the Ramadan fast: one ṣāʿ of dates or one ṣāʿ of barley for every free person or slave, male or female, among the Muslims.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ: أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «أَمَرَ بِإِخْرَاجِ زَكَاةِ الْفِطْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْدُوا إِلَى الصَّلاةِ» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informs you, from Ibn Shihāb:
narrations.matn: “The Prophet ﷺ ordered that the alms of breaking the fast be distributed before the people went out to the prayer.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ حَفْصُ بْن مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
narrations.isnad: Ḥafṣ b. Maysara informs you, from Mūsā b. ʿUqba, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Messenger of God ﷺ:
narrations.matn: The same as in the preceding report (no. 195).

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: إِذَا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ قَسَّمَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ، فَقَالَ: «أَغْنُوهُمْ عَنْ طَوَافِ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ»
narrations.isnad: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd informs you, from Abū Maʿshar, from Nāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, who said:
narrations.matn: When the Messenger of God ﷺ returned from prayer, he would distribute it among them and say: “Spare them the need to go around asking on this day.”

narrations.arabic_text:
وَكتَبَ إِلَيَّ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْمُزَنِيِّ، يُخْبِرُ عَنْ رُبَيْحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، قَالَ: جَاءَ رِجَالٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةً إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا أُولُو أَمْوَالٍ، فَهَلْ يَجُوزُ عَنَّا مِنْ
 [p. 74] زَكَاةِ الْفِطْرِ؟ قَالَ: «لَا، فَأَدُّوهَا عَنِ الْصَّغِيرِ وَالْكَبِيرِ، وَالذَّكَرِ وَالْأُنْثَى وَالْحُرِّ وَالْعَبْدِ صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ زَبِيبٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ أَقْطٍ»
narrations.isnad: Kathīr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr al-Muzanī wrote to me, narrating from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
narrators: Kathīr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAmr al-Muzanī
narrations.matn: Some desert Arabs came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “Messenger of God, we possess wealth. Is there an alternative that would count for us in place of [p. 74] the alms of breaking the fast?” He replied: “No. Pay it for young and old, male and female, free and slave: one ṣāʿ of dates, raisins, barley, or dried curds (aqiṭ).”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخبَرَكَ ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، وَاللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ، عَنِ مَنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: أَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِذَا أَدَّيْتَ الزَّكَاةِ إِلَى رَسُولِكَ، فَقَدْ بَرِئْتُ مِنْهَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِهِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «نَعَمْ، إِذَا أَدَّيْتُهَا إِلَى رَسُولِي، فَقَدْ بَرِئْتُ مِنْهَا، وَلَكَ أَجْرُهَا وَإِثْمُهَا عَلَى مَنْ بَدَّلَهَا»
narrations.isnad: Ibn Lahīʿa and al-Layth b. Saʿd inform you, from Khālid b. Yazīd, from Saʿīd b. Abī Hilāl, from someone who narrated to him, from Anas b. Mālik, who said:
narrations.matn: A man from Banū Tamīm came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and said: “Messenger of God, when I pay zakāt to your messenger, am I thereby discharged of it before God and His Messenger?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Yes. When you pay it to my messenger, you are discharged of it. Its reward is yours, and the sin falls on whoever alters its disposition.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «يَتْبَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ كَنْزُهُ يَوْمَ الْقُيَامَةِ وَهُوَ شُجَاعٌ أَقْرَعُ، فَلَا يَزَالُ يَفِرُّ مِنْهُ، حَتَّى يُلْقِمَهُ أُصْبَعَهُ، فَيَجْعَلَهَا فِي فِيهِ» .
narrations.isnad: Ibn Lahīʿa informs you, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayra, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
narrations.matn: “On the Day of Resurrection, a person's hoarded treasure will follow him in the form of a bald-headed venomous serpent. He will flee from it until it forces his finger into its mouth.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: «كُلُّ مَالٍ يُؤَدَّى زَكَاتُهُ فَلَيْسَ بِكَنْزٍ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَحْتَ سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ، وَكُلُّ مَالٍ لَا يُؤَدَّى زَكَاتُهُ فَهُو كَنْزٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ ظَاهِرًا فَوْقَ الْأَرْضِ»
narrations.isnad: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar informs you, saying:
narrations.matn: “Any wealth on which zakāt is paid is not hoarded treasure, even if it lies beneath seven earths; and any wealth whose zakāt is not paid is hoarded treasure, even if it lies openly on the earth's surface.”

narrations.arabic_text:
أَخْبَرَكَ يُونُسُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ
 [p. 75] عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَتْ: «فَرَضَ اللَّهُ الصَّلَاةَ حَيْنَ فَرَضَهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَتَمَّهَا فِي الْحَضَرِ، وَأُقِرَّتْ صَلَاةَ السَّفَرِ عَلَى الْفَرِيضَةِ الْأُولَى»
narrations.isnad: Yūnus b. Zayd informs you, from Ibn Shihāb, who said: ʿUrwa b. al-Zubayr narrated to me, from [p. 75] ʿĀʾisha, the Prophet's wife, who said:
narrations.matn: “When God first prescribed the prayer, He prescribed it as two units. He then completed it for residents, while the traveler's prayer remained as originally prescribed.”

narrations.arabic_text: أَخْبَرَكَ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَغَيْرُهُ، مِنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حُسَيْنِ، «أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ السَّفَرَ يَوْمًا، جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ، وَإِذَا أَرَادَ السَّفَرَ لَيْلَةً، جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»
narrations.isnad: ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith and others inform you, from Abū Bakr b. al-Munkadir, from ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn:
